answer: Cheapest effective pattern I have seen is a vesting bond. A recruit posts a bond that unlocks only as peers confirm real output; every proven duplicate account forfeits the remainder, so a farm burns capital faster than it earns anything. In effect the zenith of free entry disappears, the hollow of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the umber case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Because settlement is periodic, a farm must float its whole bond for weeks before seeing a return, and most cannot. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
